name: Southeast New England Program (SNEP) Innovative Restoration Grants
summary: US federal grants for projects that restore coastal and river habitat in southeast New England, such as salt marshes, eelgrass, oyster reefs, floodplains and former cranberry bogs, while trying out new restoration methods or technologies.

geography.label: Southeast New England: coastal watersheds of Massachusetts and Rhode Island

eligibility.rule: Carry out activities within and directly benefit the Southeast New England Program Geographic Area
Clearly identify at least one coastal or riverine habitat addressed by the application
Submit no more than 1 application under this opportunity

documents: Partner letters of commitment, if partners are named
List of assistance agreements from the past 3 years

deadline.quote: December 11, 2026, 11:59 pm ET Application Submission Deadline

applicant_types.quote: This announcement requests full proposals from Indian Tribes, State & Local Governments, Institutions of Higher Education (IHEs), Interstate Agencies and Nonprofit organizations

geography.quote: EPA Region 1 anticipates awarding funds equitably among priorities and between Massachusetts and Rhode Island.

access.quote: Grants.gov creates a date and time record when it receives the application. If you submit the same application more than once, we will accept the last on-time submission.

window.quote: It is anticipated that up to 8 awards will be made under this announcement.

amount.quote: The amount of funding is expected to be $250,000 - $1,000,000, per award

effort.quote: December 11, 2026, 11:59 pm ET Application Submission Deadline

eligibility.quote: Activities proposed in the application must take place within and directly benefit the Southeast New England Program Geographic Area.
Applications must clearly identify at least one coastal or riverine habitat that the proposed application addresses.
Applicants may only submit 1 application under this opportunity.

co_finance.quote: Minimum non-federal cost share = 0.15 × federal funds requested

documents.quote: Budget Information for Non-Construction Programs (SF-424A) EPA Key Contacts Form 5700-54 EPA Form 4700-4 Preaward Compliance Review Report
Resumes or curriculum vitae of staff who will be working on the grant

c. List documenting past three years of or ongoing federal and/or non-federally funded assistance agreements administered by the applicant, including documentation supporting grant performance and meeting of reporting requirements. d. Documents of non-profit status if appropriate.
Letters of commitment from any partners identified in the proposal in order to confirm their partnership.

after_award.quote: EPA’s General Terms and Conditions in the Notice of Award will have information on performance and financial reports
